title: Sign the Petition
content: Hello everyone. I need all of your help. Right now, as we speak, the Worthington shopping mall located in Worthington, Ohio is not doing so well. Ever since direct retail partners bought the mall out, they have done a terrible job at promoting the Mall. First, Covid happened. That obviously screwed the mall up big time. However, when society started coming back together, they never did anything to promote the mall and bring it back to its original glory. Businesses and stores have left because of it. In addition, there is a furniture store where I interviewed the owner of the store one time. His business used to be booming with customers. Now, it’s not, due to the failures of direct retail partners. I don’t know how many Mall people on here are able to make a trip to the Worthington Mall, but I ask that you do so that way you know what the mall looks like. I even have pictures of what the Mall looked like before Covid found on my petition. By signing this, you are helping put pressure on direct retail partners to do good things with them all. You are giving them a reason why the mall should not be taken down. I should point out that they literally don’t know what to do with the mall. There are times where they will decide to take it down, and there are times where they will decide not to. I need everyone’s help in signing this petition. It is truly appreciated. Thank you!
